text: 大连首条欧式沉浸式消费街区开业 投资8000余万元打造文商旅融合新地标 2026年10月1日，正值国庆佳节，大连市金普新区迎来文旅商业领域的重磅事件——由大连建华集团投资8000余万元建设运营的栖栖里艺术街区正式开门迎客。
text_en: Dalian's first European-style immersive consumer street opens, with over 80 million yuan invested to create a new landmark integrating culture, commerce and tourism. On October 1, 2026, during the National Day holiday, Dalian's Jinpu New Area welcomed a major event in the cultural tourism and commercial sector — Qiqili Art Street, built and operated by Dalian Jianhua Group with an investment of over 80 million yuan, officially opened to the public.
